symptomShortText: Pitting on anodized bezel frames rinsed in tank 3 - chloride carry-over from open city water bypass

defect.defectText: Pitting corrosion and dark discoloration on anodized aluminum bezel

causesIshikawa.description: Racking operator followed the standard rack pattern
Rinse tank 3 pumps and heaters working, no alarm
City water bypass valve on rinse tank 3 left open after resin change - no lock-out step in DOC-7105, chloride rose to 42 mg/l
Aluminium 6063 extrusion lot EX-9120 within specification
Conductivity probe CP-03 read only at shift start

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the bezel frames show pitting?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Up to 11 pits per frame against zero allowed, all on frames rinsed in tank 3

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did tank 3 rinsing cause pitting?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Rinse water chloride reached 42 mg/l against max 5 mg/l and attacked the fresh oxide

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was there chloride in the rinse tank? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The city water bypass valve was left open after the resin change because the procedure has no lock-out step

actions.actionText: Quarantine batch B-50540 frames and sort all finished frames under 10x magnification
Flush rinse tank 3, close the city water bypass valve and restore DI water supply
Lock out the city water bypass valves and add conductivity monitoring alarm on all rinse tanks

fmeaLink.description: Pitting from chloride contamination of DI rinse water

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Tracing rejects to the rinse tank number on the rack card found the source in two days
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Valve positions after maintenance were not verified or locked

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: BF-10 visible faces - WC-ANOD-01 rinse tank 3 - batch B-50540, July 2026
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Frames rinsed in tank 4 - same extrusion lot EX-9120
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the rinse tank, not the alloy lot
